citations.claim: At step 1 the controller applied 6.5 N (over fmax=5) producing this motion
Body started at rest so excess force is entirely controller command

explanation: Controller with kp=100, vcmd=20 and noise=1 commands ~6.5 N on first step, exceeding fmax=5. The velocity-error law plus seeded sensor noise is not clamped to fmax before application.
vision_note: The controller-driven body appears red on the left side far from the green waypoint in the top right, indicating it is the violator at step 1. It shows almost no visible motion between step 0 and step 1, so the failure is not an escape or penetration but an internal force-limit exceedance.
